description: Rewrite a speech into a clear structure (PREP, STAR, problem-solution, rule of three and others) chosen to fit it. Returns the rewritten sections, the structure with a 1-10 score for how well the original already followed it, a summary of what changed and one delivery tip. Input: 30-1500 words. Shares the daily text allowance with analyze_transcript.

context.description: What the speech is for, so the feedback is calibrated to it. Defaults to general.

topic.description: The question or prompt being answered, e.g. an IELTS cue card or interview question

transcript.description: What was said, as plain text: 30-1500 words. Paste a speech transcript or a draft you plan to say out loud.

name: refine_transcript

structureScore.description: How well the original already followed it, 1-10

title: Restructure a speech
